items.question: 오늘 강남지점 체결 건수와 거래대금 알려줘
items.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.BRANCH b ON c.BRANCH_CODE = b.BRANCH_CODE WHERE b.BRANCH_NAME = '강남지점' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE

runs.sql:
SELECT COUNT(EXECUTIONS.EXEC_ID) AS EXEC_COUNT,
       SUM(EXECUTIONS.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS EXECUTIONS
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS ORDERS ON EXECUTIONS.ORDER_ID = ORDERS.ORDER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT ACCOUNT ON ORDERS.ACCOUNT_ID = ACCOUNT.ACCOUNT_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER CUSTOMER ON ACCOUNT.CUSTOMER_ID = CUSTOMER.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.BRANCH BRANCH ON CUSTOMER.BRANCH_CODE = BRANCH.BRANCH_CODE
WHERE DATE(EXECUTIONS.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE
  AND BRANCH.BRANCH_NAME = '강남지점'

items.question: 삼성전자 어제 체결 중 매수만 보여줘
items.golden_sql: SELECT e.EXEC_ID, e.EXEC_QTY, e.EXEC_PRICE FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE p.PRODUCT_NAME = '삼성전자' AND o.SIDE = 'BUY' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY

runs.sql:
SELECT E.EXEC_ID, E.EXEC_TS, E.EXEC_QTY, E.EXEC_PRICE, E.EXEC_AMOUNT
FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS E
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS O ON E.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_CODE = P.PRODUCT_CODE
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NAME = '삼성전자'
  AND DATE(E.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY
  AND O.SIDE = 'BUY'

items.question: VIP 고객 중 예수금 많은 순으로 10명
items.golden_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(b.CASH_BALANCE) AS CASH FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY b ON b.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE c.GRADE = 'VIP' AND b.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY CASH DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

runs.sql:
SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(BD.CASH_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_CASH
FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER C
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT A ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY BD ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = BD.ACCOUNT_ID
WHERE C.GRADE = 'VIP'
  AND BD.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY)
GROUP BY C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME
ORDER BY TOTAL_CASH DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

       SUM(E.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXEC_AMOUNT

items.question: 종목별 거래대금을 업종 내에서 순위 매겨줘
items.golden_sql: SELECT p.SECTOR, p.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.SECTOR ORDER BY SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) DESC) AS RNK FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY p.SECTOR, p.PRODUCT_NAME

runs.sql:
SELECT P.SECTOR,
       P.PRODUCT_CODE,
       P.PRODUCT_NAME,
       SUM(E.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXEC_AMOUNT,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY P.SECTOR ORDER BY SUM(E.EXEC_AMOUNT) DESC) AS SECTOR_RANK
FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS E
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS O ON E.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_CODE = P.PRODUCT_CODE
GROUP BY P.SECTOR, P.PRODUCT_CODE, P.PRODUCT_NAME

items.question: 한도 대비 노출금액 비율이 80%를 넘는 데스크가 있어?
items.golden_sql: SELECT d.DESK_NAME FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS s JOIN FIN_DEMO.DESK d ON s.DESK_ID = d.DESK_ID WHERE s.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS) GROUP BY d.DESK_NAME, d.LIMIT_AMOUNT HAVING SUM(s.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT > 0.8

runs.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) AS max_date
    FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS
),
exposure_per_desk AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.DESK_ID,
        SUM(sp.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) AS total_exposure
    FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS sp
    JOIN latest_date ld ON sp.BASE_DATE = ld.max_date
    GROUP BY sp.DESK_ID
)
SELECT 
    d.DESK_ID,
    d.DESK_NAME,
    d.LIMIT_AMOUNT,
    e.total_exposure,
    DECIMAL(e.total_exposure / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT * 100, 5, 2) || '%' AS RATIO
FROM exposure_per_desk e
JOIN FIN_DEMO.DESK d ON e.DESK_ID = d.DESK_ID
WHERE e.total_exposure / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT > 0.8
